text.p: The Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) on Thursday decided to postpone Cambodia's membership into the grouping, Malaysia's national news agency Bernama said quoting sources.
Bernama quoted its sources as saying the foreign ministers have agreed to accept Laos and Burma as ASEAN members on July 24 as scheduled.
ASEAN's chairman Malaysian Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi was expected to make an official announcement on the matter at a news conference scheduled for 1530 (0730 gmt) on Thursday.

ASEAN had planned to admit Cambodia, along with Burma and Laos at its annual meeting at the end of this month in Kuala Lumpur until Cambodian Second Prime Minister Hun Sen's bloody power grab over the weekend.

At least 58 people have died and up to 200 wounded in clashes between forces loyal to Hun Sen and those of his rival, First Prime Minister Norodom Ranariddh. Two of the victims were senior Ranariddh officials who were shot dead.
